'''Myron Beech''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] ranger who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ok. I have information from three spots. The trail leader radioed in at three spots along the trail. I'll give you those locations. Maybe you can find something there.|Myron Beech, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DGI" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Myron Beech was organizing hiking trails in the [[Nomad Mountains|Thaos Mountains]].<ref name="SWG:DGI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one of his hiking group that included the man named [[Ilyamo]] disappeared in the mountains. Beech was interrogated by a spacer working for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:DGI" /> The spacer later discovered that the hikers were captured by the criminals known as the [[cave-dwellers]].<ref name="SWG:DFtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Finding the Culprits|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Myron Beech appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DGI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Myron Beech was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
